title: GESA: Graph-Enhanced Semantic Allocation for Generalized, Fair, and Explainable Candidate-Role Matching
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness and demographic bias mitigation in a candidate-role matching system. While it addresses 'fairness' and 'bias,' which are ethical concepts in AI, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, theology, or specific moral/ethical reasoning systems as its primary component.
